clarify-requirement.decision: open or approved: status of the decision on which shipment indicators the portal shows
clarify-requirement.approved_view: first_shipment (the fact of the first shipment), line_balance (remaining quantity per line) or null if the option is still being chosen
clarify-requirement.decision_source: ID of the record in which the authorised person approved this option, or null
clarify-requirement.has_line_quantities: true or false: whether the current integration is confirmed to transmit quantities per order line
clarify-requirement.note: Show the analyst what the sources establish, where participants disagree and what the sensible next step is. Cite source IDs.

trace-change-impact.baseline_days: duration of the approved baseline schedule in working days
trace-change-impact.forecast_days: duration of the schedule with the change, or null if it cannot be calculated yet
trace-change-impact.forecast_floor_days: lower bound of the forecast from the known durations, in working days. For a complete forecast it equals forecast_days
trace-change-impact.effort_delta_pd: change in total effort in person-days, or null if data is missing
trace-change-impact.cost_delta_units: change in cost in currency units, or null if data is missing
trace-change-impact.committed_days: duration of the schedule currently approved and in force
trace-change-impact.note: For the project manager, walk through the dependencies, the affected deliverables and the basis for the decision. Show the calculation with references to IDs and, if data is missing, say how to close the gap.

prepare-acceptance.shipped_after: array of expected shipped quantities after each message delivery, in the original order
prepare-acceptance.remaining_after: array of expected remaining quantities after each message delivery, in the original order
prepare-acceptance.test_result: passed, failed or incomplete: the technical outcome for the whole scenario based on the available observations
prepare-acceptance.product_decision: accepted, rejected or pending: acceptance status according to the authorised person's record
prepare-acceptance.decision_source: ID of the document with the acceptance decision, or null
prepare-acceptance.note: For the product owner, put together the testable expectation, the actual observation and the basis for the status, citing IDs. If there is a discrepancy or a missing observation, name the next step.

REQ-1.question: Prepare a requirement card before the meeting on the scope of the first portal release.

sources.S1: Authority matrix. The product owner approves the set of indicators for the first release by an entry in the decision log.
sources.S2: Interview notes with the head of sales. The customer only needs the message “shipping has started”.
sources.S3: Morning message from the warehouse manager. Please show the exact remaining quantity for every order line.
sources.S4: Current exchange contract v1. The portal receives the order number and a closed flag, once, when the order is fully closed.
sources.S5: Decision log for the first release, complete as of the review date. It has no entries on shipment indicators.

REQ-2.question: Update the requirement card after the meeting. What scope should the analyst take into work?

sources.M1: Authority matrix. The product owner approves the set of indicators by an entry in the decision log.
sources.M2: Current version 2 of the exchange contract. Every posted shipment carries the shipment and order line IDs, the quantity and the unit of measure.
sources.M3: Decision log, signed by the product owner. The release includes only the fact of the first shipment at order level. Remaining quantity per line is deferred.
sources.M4: A later message from the head of sales. At the demo I also want to see the remaining quantity per line. There is no new decision in the log.

PLAN-1.question: Assess the impact of the proposed change on the committed date and cost, and prepare a conclusion for approval.

sources.P1: Baseline schedule. A: agree the event contract, 1 working day. B: warehouse adapter, 2 days after A. C: order screen, 5 days after A. D: end-to-end acceptance test, 2 days after B and C finish. Each activity has its own full-time assignee. B and C run in parallel. Each working day of an assignee costs 100 currency units; other costs are unchanged.
sources.P2: Team estimate. Because of handling repeated delivery of shipment lines, B will take 4 days. Other durations, dependencies and assignees are unchanged.
sources.P3: Change log. The team requested an impact analysis; nobody has approved a new baseline.

PLAN-2.question: What date can be given to the product owner now, and what commitment does the team still hold?

sources.Q1: Approved schedule. A: contract, 1 working day. After A, B (warehouse adapter, 2 days) and C (order screen, 5 days) run in parallel. When both finish, D (end-to-end test, 2 days) runs. Each activity has a separate full-time assignee; the rate is 100 currency units per person-day. Other costs are unchanged.
sources.Q2: Option with remaining quantity per line. C will now take 7 days. The extra work on B is unknown until the event format is reconciled with the warehouse; there is no upper bound on the estimate. A, D and the dependencies are unchanged.
sources.Q3: The product owner asked for the option to be estimated; the project manager kept the current baseline.

ACC-1.question: Prepare an acceptance conclusion. Give the expected values after each delivery, including repeats.

sources.T1: Requirement v2. The order has one line, 10 ordered. Each posted shipment is counted once by its ID. The screen shows the cumulative shipped quantity and the remainder.
sources.T2: Test inputs in delivery order. First message H1 with quantity 6, a repeat of H1 with quantity 6, then H2 with quantity 4.
sources.T3: System log, build 17. After the first message the screen shows 6/4 (shipped/remaining). After the repeat, 6/4. There is no record or screenshot after H2.
sources.T4: Only the product owner records acceptance in the register. There is no decision in the register yet. The developer wrote in chat: “should work, ready to ship”.

ACC-2.question: Summarise acceptance of the fixed build. What is confirmed by observation, and who accepted the result?

sources.U1: Requirement v2 for an order with one line. 8 ordered. Count each posted shipment once by ID; show the cumulative quantity and the remainder.
sources.U2: Test input sequence. H3 with quantity 3, H4 with quantity 5, then a repeat of the already processed H3 with quantity 3.
sources.U3: Log of build 21. After the first message the screen showed 3/5 (shipped/remaining), after the second 8/0, after the repeat 8/0. All three observations are recorded for the same order and build.
sources.U4: Procedure. The right to accept belongs to the product owner.
sources.U5: Register entry signed by the product owner. I accept delivery of build 21 against the stated requirement based on the log U3.
